text.Bioformer:
Bioformer Bioformer.jpg Colony Wars Blob Base 4 defense 4 2 3 3 
 How to Play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 3 Combat. You can also scrap it to gain 3 Trade. 
 Strategy==
The 3 Combat is decent considering the cost, as is the 4 defense. However, most of the time this card is bought and later scrapped in order to buy a more expensive card.
